source_pr_title: Don't override container command by default
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: Container command is always set to DEFAULT_COMMAND even when not provided. This overrides the OCI image's entrypoint, contradicting the PR objective of only setting command when explicitly provided. When `props.command` is undefined, `values.command` will be set to `['devenv', 'up']`, which then gets assigned to the container spec at line 307, preventing the image's native entrypoint from executing.
```suggestion
      command: props.command,
```

source_pr_title: Don't override container command by default
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: Setting `command: undefined` in the container spec will include an explicit `undefined` value in the Kubernetes manifest. This could cause deployment failures. When command is not provided, the field should be omitted entirely from the container specification to allow the image's ENTRYPOINT to execute.
```suggestion
          ...(values.command ? { command: values.command } : {}),
```
